lines.text: Abimelech and Phicol ask Abraham to swear not to deal falsely with them, and Abraham says he swears it.
Abraham complains about a seized well, and Abimelech says he did not know who did it.
Abraham gives Abimelech sheep and cattle, and the seven ewe lambs are to be a witness that he dug the well.
The place is called Bethel after their oath, and Abimelech and Phicol then return to the land of the Philistines.
Abraham plants a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, calls on the LORD, and soon leaves the land of the Philistines.

wrong_details.wrong: soon leaves the land of the Philistines
wrong_details.true: resided in the land of the Philistines for a long time
